title: Cutshort Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, locations, remote or office, job type, pay as shown and as numbers, experience, skills, funding stage, company type and size, posting dates and job link, and with details on the description. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: Cutshort jobs read, matched and saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
